In 2024 Q3, Gross Profit = 19474 - 15626 = 3848, so Gross Profit Margin = 3848/19474 = 19.75%. **Overall Sentiment:**

The combination of explosive revenue growth, dramatically improved profitability metrics, and a strong increase in equity makes for a very positive outlook. While further investigation into the 'Other Liabilities' increase is advised, the overall financial health of the company appears to be in excellent condition, justifying a high positive sentiment score.
